name: MonarchUsernameAvailabilityInput
title: UsernameAvailabilityInput
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField with LaunchedEffect and kotlinx.coroutines.delay for the debounced check
summary: A text field whose value is checked while the person types, such as a handle or a workspace address, with a status message, an announced result and a retry after a failure.
whenToUse: For a value that must be unique on a service: a handle, a workspace address, a slug. The app supplies the check.
whenNotToUse: For checks that need no service, validate on submit with MonarchTextField and its errorText. For search-as-you-type use the Material 3 SearchBar.
api: @Composable fun MonarchUsernameAvailabilityInput(value: String, label: String, onValueChange: (String) -> Unit, validate: suspend (String) -> MonarchUsernameAvailabilityResult?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, prefix: String? = null, debounceMillis: Long = 400L, enabled: Boolean = true, transform: ((String) -> String)? = null, onStatusChange: ((MonarchUsernameAvailabilityStatus, String?) -> Unit)? = null, statusIcon: (@Composable (MonarchUsernameAvailabilityStatus) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchUsernameAvailabilityInputLabels = MonarchUsernameAvailabilityInputLabels(), keyboardActions: KeyboardActions = KeyboardActions.Default, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)
class MonarchUsernameAvailabilityResult(valid: Boolean, message: String? = null)
enum class MonarchUsernameAvailabilityStatus { Idle, Checking, Valid, Invalid, Error }
class MonarchUsernameAvailabilityInputLabels(checking: String? = null, valid: String? = null, invalid: String? = null, error: String? = null, retry: String? = null)

options.name: value
options.description: The text to edit and check.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with the new text, after transform.

options.name: validate
options.description: The check. Return null when there is nothing to check. Throwing sets the Error status. Cancelled when the text changes.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: An example shown while the field is empty and focused.

options.name: helperText
options.description: Supporting text under the field, shown while there is no status message.

options.name: prefix
options.description: Fixed text before the value, such as a domain.

options.name: debounceMillis
options.description: How long typing must pause before the check runs.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the person can edit the field.

options.name: transform
options.description: Rewrites typed text before it is stored, such as lower-casing.

options.name: onStatusChange
options.description: Called when the status or its message changes, not for the first status.

options.name: statusIcon
options.description: An icon after the text for the settled statuses. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Checking availability…", "Available", "Not available", "Couldn’t check availability." and "Try again".

options.name: keyboardActions
options.description: What happens when the person triggers the IME action.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the focus and press interactions of the field.

states.name: idle
states.description: A plain field; the helper text shows.

states.name: checking
states.description: A progress indicator at the end of the field and "Checking availability…" under it, in the muted text color.

states.name: valid
states.description: The success border at rest and the message in the success color.

states.name: invalid
states.description: The field's error state: the danger border, the message in the danger color and the error semantics.

states.name: error
states.description: The message in the warning color and a "Try again" button.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The disabled field; the retry button is disabled too.

appearance: The same field as MonarchTextField: the input border, the focus ring role when focused, the success strong role for the border of a free value and the danger strong role for a taken one. The message under the field uses the muted, success strong, danger strong or warning strong role by status. The prefix is in the muted text role. All roles come from the theme.
platformNotes: The web passes an AbortSignal to the check; on Android the check runs in a LaunchedEffect coroutine that is cancelled when the text changes, which also cancels suspend calls made in it. The web has sm, md and lg sizes; Android has the one size of MonarchTextField, as iOS does. The web reports the first idle status on mount; onStatusChange runs on changes only, as on iOS. The web draws its own status glyphs; Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so statusIcon is a slot and the message carries the meaning. Built-in strings are replaced through one labels value. The Material 3 prefix is shown when the field is focused or has text. It is built on OutlinedTextField with the colors of MonarchTextField rather than on MonarchTextField itself, because that has no prefix slot and no success state. Monarch does no networking.
accessibility: The field is a Material 3 text field named by its label.
Settled results ("Available", "Not available", a failure) are announced through a polite live region; "Checking" is not.
A taken value sets the error semantics with its message.
Each status has its own message in words, not color alone; the progress indicator is hidden from TalkBack.
The "Try again" button is a separate element with a 48dp touch target.
Autocorrection and capitalisation are off. Text grows with the font size setting and the message wraps.
edgeCases: Empty text is idle and is never checked.
A check cancelled by new typing never writes its result, so the status always describes the latest text.
"Try again" runs the check at once, without the wait.
The message returned by the check replaces the built-in and replaced texts.
Changing validate does not start a new check; the next edit does.

examples.title: Workspace address
examples.template:
MonarchUsernameAvailabilityInput(
    value = address,
    label = {{label}},
    onValueChange = { address = it },
    validate = { candidate -> MonarchUsernameAvailabilityResult(valid = candidate !in setOf({{taken.0}}, {{taken.1}}, {{taken.2}}, {{taken.3}})) },
    placeholder = {{placeholder}},
    helperText = {{description}},
    prefix = {{prefix}},
    required = {{required}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchUsernameAvailabilityInput(
    value = address,
    label = "Workspace address",
    onValueChange = { address = it },
    validate = { candidate -> MonarchUsernameAvailabilityResult(valid = candidate !in setOf("admin", "help", "support", "team")) },
    placeholder = "your-team",
    helperText = "Try “team” to see a taken address.",
    prefix = "example.com/",
    required = true,
)
